description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named TimerControls, which displays the current timer status, mode, task name input, and control buttons for a Pomodoro timer application.

classes.name: TimerControls
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays timer information, session mode, task input (for focus sessions), and control buttons.

methods.name: _format
methods.description: Formats a Duration object into a string of format HH:MM:SS or MM:SS depending on duration length.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for TimerControls, displaying session info, remaining time, optional task input, and control buttons according to the current session state.
